title: Foundation-Style Pretraining for Scalable and Transferable Distributed PV Forecasting
abstract: arXiv:2610.27763v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: The rapid growth of distributed photovoltaic (PV) generation is increasing the demand for accurate forecasting across large numbers of geographically dispersed stations. Existing approaches are commonly developed for individual sites or specific forecasting horizons, requiring repeated training and maintenance as new stations are integrated and limiting direct reuse at previously unseen sites. To address this scalability gap, this paper presents a domain-specific foundation-style pretraining framework that learns a shared forecasting model from heterogeneous multi-site and multi-horizon PV data. NWP-assisted forecasting is formulated as a sequence-completion problem that unifies historical PV power, meteorological observations, future numerical weather prediction (NWP) forecasts, and time encodings. translated_title: 面向可扩展且可迁移的分布式光伏预测的基础模型式预训练
translated_abstract: 分布式光伏发电的快速增长使得对大量地理分散电站进行精确预测的需求日益增加。现有方法通常针对单个站点或特定预测时域开发，随着新电站的接入需要重复训练和维护，并限制了在未见过的站点上的直接复用。为解决这一可扩展性差距，本文提出了一种面向特定领域的基础模型式预训练框架，从异构的多站点、多时域光伏数据中学习一个共享的预测模型。该框架将数值天气预报（NWP）辅助预测表述为一个序列补全问题，统一了历史光伏功率、气象观测、未来NWP预报和时间编码。设计并系统评估了三种预训练目标，包括预测对齐重建、通用重建以及……（原文摘要在此处截断）
tldr: 本文提出一种面向光伏领域的基础模型式预训练框架，通过将NWP辅助预测统一建模为序列补全问题并设计多种预训练目标，从多站点、多时域异构数据中学习共享预测模型，实现分布式光伏预测的可扩展性与对未见站点的迁移能力。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes a domain-specific foundation-style pretraining framework that formulates NWP-assisted forecasting as a sequence-completion problem and learns a shared model from heterogeneous multi-site, multi-horizon PV data, enabling scalable and transferable distributed PV forecasting to previously unseen stations.
